frame_0.text: vampire: ... today on Armageddon, I died ... and yet even at the end of my time, I still took from others...

frame_1.text: Why ... Why did I choose murder rather than face death? Borrowed time ... What did this debt give me but compounding wounds upon my soul?

frame_3.text: -Inferno! Take me, it is what I earned with my blood sucking life!

frame_4.text: It was never what you earned. It has always been a gift.
